name: dsh-plugins
author: Qihong <qihong.m.u@gmail.com>
description: User-authored external plugins for DeepSeek Harness, loaded via a dsh profile (no changes to the dsh library). Each plugin lives under packages/<plugin>/ with a host half and a client half.

scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:host && npm run build:client
